excerpt: New models, tools, and framework launches in the AI/LLM world.

  • ⚡ Capability — WISP streaming engine runs 2T+ MoE models like Kimi K3 on consumer hardware via 3-tier streaming [21]

  • 🛠️ Tool — Show HN: Ctrlb-decompose strips noise from logs before LLM processing, reducing token usage [10]
  • 🛠️ Tool — Andrew Ng releases OpenWorker, an open-source local AI agent using Ollama [17]
  • 🛠️ Tool — Agent Mini: a minimal, local-first AI agent (~3k lines Python) using Ollama, avoiding large frameworks [8]

Today

43 items

Agent Release

Agent Mini: a minimal, local-first AI agent you can actually read, understand, and extend.

A developer released Agent Mini, a ~3k-line Python agent that uses Ollama by default and includes tools for shell, files, web search, memory, and vision. It avoids large frameworks like LangChain, relying only on asyncio, httpx, and a small ReAct loop tuned for local/smaller models.

1 engagement1 sourceredditTue, Jul 28, 2026, 01:49 PM

Tool Release

Badgr launches ephemeral agent environments for running full-machine tasks

Badgr provides a CLI tool that spins up fresh machines for AI agents needing Docker, databases, browsers, or GPUs, runs the job, returns logs and files, caps spend, then deletes itself. It supports launching agents like Cline, Claude, Codex, or custom tasks. This addresses the infrastructure gap for smaller teams running agents that require full machine access.

8 engagement1 sourceredditTue, Jul 28, 2026, 05:46 AM

Tool Release

Developer builds per-weight-group quantization tool for Qwen3.6-27B, releases three builds

A developer created a harness that quantizes one weight group at a time and measures KL divergence against the full-precision model across general, code, math, and tool-calling prompts. The tool produces three builds: Bedrock, Tightrope, and Gambit, each with different quantization strategies.

代理发布

Agent Mini：一个最小的、本地优先的 AI 代理，您可以实际阅读、理解和扩展。

开发人员发布了 Agent Mini，这是一个约 3k 行的 Python 代理，默认使用 Ollama，并包含 shell、文件、网络搜索、内存和视觉工具。 它避免了像 LangChain 这样的大型框架，仅依赖于 asyncio、httpx 和针对本地/较小模型调整的小型 ReAct 循环。

1 参与 1 来源reddit 2026 年 7 月 28 日星期二 1:49 PM

工具释放

Badgr 推出用于运行全机任务的临时代理环境

Badgr 提供了一个 CLI 工具，可以为需要 Docker、数据库、浏览器或 GPU 的 AI 代理启动新机器，运行作业，返回日志和文件，限制支出，然后删除自身。 它支持启动 Cline、Claude、Codex 等代理或自定义任务。 这解决了运行需要完全机器访问权限的代理的小型团队的基础设施差距。

8 参与1 来源reddit 2026 年 7 月 28 日星期二 05:46

工具释放

开发人员为 Qwen3.6-27B 构建按权重组量化工具，发布三个版本

开发人员创建了一种工具，可以一次量化一个权重组，并根据通用、代码、数学和工具调用提示的全精度模型测量 KL 散度。 该工具生成三种构建：Bedrock、Tightrope 和 Gambit，每种构建都有不同的量化策略。
